nota:
Both the checkbox column and the actions column headers are currently empty, which means a screen reader will announce them as "Column header, blank" or simply "Column header."

Root Cause
Checkbox Header: The cell contains only an <input type="checkbox"> without any associated text or aria-label. Screen readers need a name for the header itself to explain that the column contains selection boxes.
Actions Header: The cell is completely empty (<th ...></th>), providing no context that this column contains action buttons (like "Edit" or "Delete").
